purpose: Current point-in-time fully diluted share schedule. This is the single denominator for every present-day relative valuation output (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDAR, P/FCF, SOTP decomposition, Per-User).
explicitlyNot: the weighted-average diluted count reported in EPS (diagnostic only, per P10.4 contract)
the DCF terminal-year share roll produced by src/engine/shares.js projectShares (P10.4 contract: 'They must not receive the DCF terminal share roll')

basicPeriodEnd.label: Basic period-end shares outstanding (Class A + Class B)

incrementalOptions.label: Incremental options (treasury stock method)
incrementalOptions.treasuryStockMethodPriceDerivation: WAEP 21.09 + (aggregate intrinsic value 60,408k / 636,000 options = 95.00) = 116.09. The price is derived from the filing's own aggregate intrinsic value so the whole schedule is single-source and single-date, rather than mixing a 2026-06-30 share count with a later market price.

citation.statement: Stockholders' Equity - Schedule of Stock Option Activity (Details)

incrementalOptions.crossValidation: The filing's own Q2 2026 dilutive effect of options is 519,000 (weighted-average basis). The point-in-time treasury-stock-method increment computed here is 520,458, i.e. within 0.3% of the issuer's own figure, which corroborates the method and the price input.

rsusAndOtherAwards.label: RSUs and other outstanding equity awards (issuer-disclosed dilutive effect)
rsusAndOtherAwards.note: Issuer-disclosed dilutive effect of RSUs outstanding for the three months ended 2026-06-30. This is the incremental figure after the treasury-stock-method treatment of unrecognised compensation cost, not the gross RSU roll-forward, and is therefore the correct addition to a diluted count.

citation.statement: Earnings Per Share - Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted (Details)

founderAwards.label: Founder awards where performance conditions have been met
founderAwards.note: Zero included because no founder award met its performance condition as of 2026-06-30. The comparable line was 720,000 for the three months ended 2025-06-30, so this is a real decline in met founder awards, not a missing disclosure. Had founder awards met, the schedule would rise by that amount.

citation.statement: Earnings Per Share - Schedule of Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted (Details)

reconciliation.note: The issuer's weighted-average diluted count is 30,458 shares (0.06%) below the point-in-time schedule. That closeness is a sanity check, not an identity: a weighted average cannot serve as a present-day denominator because it blends periods and, here, carries founder awards that had not vested, whereas the point-in-time schedule reflects actual outstanding instruments at the measurement date.

weightedAverageDiluted.prohibition: P10.4 contract: 'Weighted-average diluted shares remain diagnostic and cannot appear as a valuation denominator.'

methodNotes: The treasury-stock-method price is disclosed explicitly and is derived from the same filing as the option count, so no cross-date mixing occurs.
At a higher market price the option increment would grow and the total would rise; the schedule is therefore a point-in-time construction, not a permanent constant.
Founder awards are reported at zero with the prior-period value disclosed, so a future vesting event is a visible change rather than a silent one.
